intro: Converting square meters (m²) to hectares (ha) is essential when translating measurements across real estate land deeds, agricultural plot surveying, flooring estimation, and architectural floor plans. One square meter equals 0.0001 hectares, while one hectare equals 10,000 square meters. Whether you are verifying specifications on technical drawings, reconciling international supplier data sheets, or checking everyday measurements, this calculator applies the exact NIST and BIPM conversion factor with instant table lookups and step-by-step worked examples.

faqs.question: How many hectares are in 1 square meter?
faqs.answer: There are 0.0001 hectares (ha) in 1 square meter (m²). To convert m² to ha, use the exact conversion factor 0.0001.

faqs.question: How do I convert square meters to hectares manually?
faqs.answer: Multiply your square meter value by 0.0001 (exact factor: 0.0001). For example, 50 m² × 0.0001 = 0.005 ha.
